criteria.text: The participant was treated on the parent pembrolizumab studies established by the Sponsor as MK-3475-587 ready.
The participant is currently receiving pembrolizumab, pembrolizumab based combinations or lenvatinib from parent studies or in a follow-up phase.
The participant has not received any anticancer systemic treatment since the last dose of pembrolizumab or a pembrolizumab-based combination in First Course Phase.
The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
The participant demonstrates adequate organ function.

The participant has resolution of any toxic effect(s) of First Course Phase trial treatment with pembrolizumab or a pembrolizumab-based combination to Grade 1 or less (except alopecia) before trial treatment in Second Course Phase is started. If the participant received major surgery or radiation therapy of >30 Gray (Gy), they must have recovered from the toxicity and/or complications of the intervention.

A female participant is eligible to enroll if she is not pregnant, not breastfeeding, and agrees to use contraception during the study treatment period and for ≥120 days (corresponding to time needed to eliminate any study combination treatment(s) plus 30 days (a menstruation cycle) for study treatments with risk of genotoxicity.
The participant has adequately controlled blood pressure (BP) to <150/90 mmHg, with or without antihypertensive medications.

A male participant agrees to be abstinent from penile-vaginal intercourse OR agrees to use a highly effective contraceptive method while receiving study drug and for 7 days after the last dose of lenvatinib.

A female participant is not pregnant/breastfeeding and at least one of the following applies during the study and for ≥4 days after: is not a woman of childbearing potential (WOCBP), is a WOCBP and uses highly effective contraception (low user dependency method OR a user dependent hormonal method in combination with a barrier method) or is a WOCBP who is abstinent from heterosexual intercourse.
There are no exclusion criteria to participate in MK-3475-587.
The participant has severe hypersensitivity (≥ Grade 3) to pembrolizumab and/or any of its excipients.
The participant has received a live vaccine within 30 days prior to the first dose of Second Course Phase trial treatment.

The participant has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency or is receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy (in dosing exceeding 10 mg daily of prednisone equivalent) or any other form of immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days prior to the Cycle 1 Day 1 of Second Course Phase.

The participant has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or requires active treatment, excluding early stage cancers (carcinoma in situ or Stage 1) treated with curative intent, melanoma (non-ulcerated, thin primary), basal cell carcinoma of the skin, squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, in situ cervical cancer, or in situ breast cancer that has undergone potentially curative therapy.
The participant has known active central nervous system metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.

The participant has an active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years (i.e., use of disease modifying agents, corticosteroids or immunosuppressive drugs). Replacement therapy (e.g. thyroxine, insulin, or physiologic corticosteroid replacement therapy for adrenal or pituitary insufficiency) is not considered a form of systemic treatment and is allowed.
The participant has a history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis that required steroids or has current pneumonitis.
Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) participants only: The participant has interstitial lung disease.
The participant has an active infection requiring systemic therapy.
The participant has a known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection.
The participant has a known history of or is positive for hepatitis B or hepatitis C.

The participant is pregnant or breastfeeding or expecting to conceive or father children within the projected duration of the study, starting with the Second Course Phase eligibility Visit through 120 days after the last dose of study treatment.

The participant has severe cardiovascular disease, i.e., arrhythmias, requiring chronic treatment, congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association Class III or IV) or symptomatic ischemic heart disease.
The participant has hepatic decompensation (Child-Pugh score >6 [class B and C]).
The participant has uncontrolled thyroid dysfunction.
The participant has uncontrolled diabetes mellitus.
The participant has had an allogeneic tissue/solid organ transplant.
The participant has a known history of active tuberculosis (TB; Bacillus tuberculosis).
The participant has had major surgery within 3 weeks prior to first dose of study intervention(s).
The participant has preexisting ≥Grade 3 gastrointestinal or non-gastrointestinal fistula.
The participant has urine protein ≥1 g/24 hours.
The participant has LVEF below the institutional (or local laboratory) normal range, as determined by multigated acquisition scan (MUGA) or echocardiogram (ECHO).
The participant has radiographic evidence of encasement or invasion of a major blood vessel, or of intratumoral cavitation.
The participant has a Prolongation of QT intervals corrected for heart rate using Fridericia's (cube root) correction (QTcF) interval to >480 ms.

The participant has clinically significant cardiovascular disease within 12 months from first dose of study intervention, including New York Heart Association Class III or IV congestive heart failure, unstable angina, myocardial infarction, cerebral vascular accident, or cardiac arrhythmia associated with hemodynamic instability.
The participant has gastrointestinal malabsorption or any other condition that might affect the absorption of lenvatinib.
The participant has active hemoptysis (bright red blood of at least 0.5 teaspoon) within 3 weeks prior to the first dose of study drug.
The participant has a history of any contraindication or has a severe hypersensitivity to any components of lenvatinib.

transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Long-term Safety and Efficacy Extension Study for Participants With Advanced Tumors Who Are Currently on Treatment or in Follow-up in a Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Study (MK-3475-587/KEYNOTE-587)". Your earlier answers already covered 9 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.text: Were you previously treated in the main pembrolizumab study (MK-3475-587)?

transcript.speaker: participant

title.registry: Long-term Safety and Efficacy Extension Study for Participants With Advanced Tumors Who Are Currently on Treatment or in Follow-up in a Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Study (MK-3475-587/KEYNOTE-587)

notADecision.ours: This isn't a decision. Your oncologist and the trial team decide whether this trial is right for you.

line.ours: 1 rule may not fit what you said. 26 rules need your records or your oncologist.

rule.registry: Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.

said.said: I'm up and about all day, but I can't do heavy jobs like gardening any more.

rule.registry: Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or requires active treatment. Exceptions include early stage cancers (carcinoma in situ or Stage 1) treated with curative intent, melanoma (non-ulcerated, thin primary), basal cell carcinoma of the skin, squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, in situ cervical cancer, or in situ breast cancer that has undergone potentially curative therapy.

asked.ours: Have you had another kind of cancer?

said.said: No, this is my first cancer.

said.said: I'd have to ask my oncologist.

rule.registry: Has an active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years (i.e., use of disease modifying agents, corticosteroids or immunosuppressive drugs).
